tex_content.label: prop:local-isometry-distance
tex_content.html:
Proposition
1. ch2:2-31

For connected Riemannian manifolds and a local isometry $\varphi :M\to \widetilde M$, $d_{\widetilde g}(\varphi (x),\varphi (y))\le d_g(x,y)$. Equality need not hold.
